reasoning: No complete English translation of Bar Hebraeus's larger Syriac grammar (Ktaba d-Semhe) has been published. The only English is Phillips 1869 (partial: one chapter on Syriac accents). Complete translations exist in German (Moberg 1907) and French (Martin 1872). Our complete English is the first of the whole work, hence first_complete.
